description: A trust verdict for any domain in one call: high/medium/low trust with named flags for very new registrations, expiry, missing or weak SPF and DMARC, too few nameservers, no web host and non-resolving domains, plus the key facts (registrar, age, nameservers, DNSSEC). Use for lead qualification, phishing and vendor checks, and before an agent sends mail to or trusts a domain. Signals only, not a guarantee. Costs $0.01 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.
name: domain-report
